Subject: Request: permission to cite your SOC 2 public link & a short security blurb for joint case study

Hi Laura,

Hope you're well — we're finishing up the joint case study draft and would like to include a brief, attributed security statement from Redwood plus a link to any public audit / SOC 2 summary you make available. Specifically: 1) permission to use Redwood's name and logo in the case study, 2) a one- or two-sentence blurb we can quote about Redwood's controls/SOC 2 status, and 3) a URL we can link to for customers who want to see your attestation or summary.

Our marketing publish target is the week of April 5; the case study will appear on blueocean.ai/case-studies and in an accompanying PDF we distribute to prospective customers. We're happy to share the draft and to include any legal/brand constraints.

Can you confirm whether the public SOC 2 summary at a Redwood-hosted URL is OK to link to, and whether you can provide a short approved blurb? If needed we can sign a logo-use agreement.

Thanks,
Samir

Hi all — quick security note and proposed wording.

Canonical public link: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2-type2-summary (this is our public-facing high-level summary page; it does not include the full audit report).

Approved short blurb (draft):
"Redwood Inference undergoes annual SOC 2 Type II assessments and maintains controls across security, availability, and confidentiality; for our public summary and attestation guidance visit https://redwood.ai/security/soc2-type2-summary."

Brand/logo: We permit the use of the Redwood logo for co-marketing case studies subject to our brand guidelines. See attached redwood-logo-guidelines.pdf for sizing, clearspace, and color rules. Any uses that modify the logo or place it in commercial materials beyond the case study will require separate written approval.

Notes:
- Do NOT reproduce or excerpt the full SOC 2 report in the case study PDF; link to the summary page instead.
- If BlueOcean wants the full report for procurement purposes, we'll provide it under NDA and tracking (separate request).

Attachments: redwood-logo-guidelines.pdf, redwood-soc2-public-summary.pdf

Regards,
